description: Retrieves a specific note by ID from Salesforce, returning all available fields. Notes with IsPrivate=true require the integration user to have sufficient permissions; inaccessible private notes will not be returned.

note_id.description: The Salesforce ID of the note to retrieve.
note_id.human_parameter_description: The Salesforce ID of the note you want to retrieve. You can copy this from the note's URL or from a previous list or search result.
note_id.title: Note Id

name: get_note

GetNoteResponse.description: Response containing a Salesforce Note record with all fields and metadata.

Body.description: The text content of the Note. Maximum length is 32,000 characters.
Body.title: Body

CreatedById.description: ID of the User who created the Note.
CreatedById.title: Created By Id

CreatedDate.description: DateTime when the Note was created, in ISO 8601 format.
CreatedDate.title: Created Date

Id.description: Unique 18-character Salesforce identifier for the Note record.
Id.title: Id

IsDeleted.description: Indicates whether the Note has been moved to the Recycle Bin (soft deleted).
IsDeleted.title: Is Deleted

IsPrivate.description: Indicates whether the Note is private and visible only to the owner and administrators.
IsPrivate.title: Is Private

LastModifiedById.description: ID of the User who last modified the Note.
LastModifiedById.title: Last Modified By Id

LastModifiedDate.description: DateTime when the Note was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.
LastModifiedDate.title: Last Modified Date

OwnerId.description: ID of the User who owns the Note.
OwnerId.title: Owner Id

ParentId.description: ID of the parent object (Account, Contact, Opportunity, etc.) that the Note is associated with.
ParentId.title: Parent Id

SystemModstamp.description: DateTime when the Note was last modified by a user or automated process, in ISO 8601 format. This is a read-only system field.
SystemModstamp.title: System Modstamp

Title.description: The title of the Note. Maximum length is 255 characters.
Title.title: Title

GetNoteResponse.title: GetNoteResponse

NoteAttributes.description: Metadata about the returned record containing object type and resource URL.

type.description: The object type, always 'Note' for Note records.
type.title: Type

url.description: The REST API resource URI for accessing this specific Note record.
url.title: Url

NoteAttributes.title: NoteAttributes
